exact_statement: For every finite-dimensional uniform Boolean f, with V4 the maximum physical-restriction-tree weighted positive rate-4 query deficit, [H(f)-4I(f)]_+ <= V4(f) <= H(f). Moreover V4=H-W4 where W4 is the minimum complete-tree weighted sum of min(entropy drop,4 queried influence). Thus existence of a universal V4<=K I bound is equivalent to full FEI, with C->K=C and K->C=K+4. An actual Boolean unbounded V4/I family would disprove FEI.
